notes: No official page could be opened directly. WebFetch failed DNS resolution (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) for EVERY host tried, official or not (sejong.korea.ac.kr, oku.korea.ac.kr, ipsi.korea.ac.kr, registrar.korea.edu, ko.wikipedia.org, dhnews.co.kr). Bash curl through the session egress proxy returned CONNECT 403 (policy reject) for every host. The only working tool was WebSearch, which returns search-engine summaries and excerpts. Most units below appear in excerpts whose cited URL is an official Korea University page or PDF (oku.korea.ac.kr is the Sejong 입학팀, sejong.korea.ac.kr, registrar.korea.ac.kr / registrar.korea.edu, scholar.korea.ac.kr). Because I never saw the page itself, every unit has source_type SECONDARY and evidence SEARCH_EXCERPT_OF_OFFICIAL_URL. Treat this as strong but unverified evidence and re-check on the live pages. Structure is for the 2026 academic year (2026학년도 모집단위, mainly from the 2026 수시모집요강 at oku.korea.ac.kr/attach/202509/1756872350076_0.pdf and the 2026 정시모집요강 / 2026 시행계획). Changes for 2026: 자유전공학부 (과학기술 / 글로벌비즈니스 / 공공정책 / 문화스포츠) [신설], a 전공자율선택제 unit. 컴퓨터융합소프트웨어학과 was renamed 컴퓨터소프트웨어학과 [명칭변경]. 디지털헬스케어공학과 and 첨단융합신약학과 were new in 2025 (27 places each). 디스플레이융합전공 and 반도체물리전공 merged into 반도체물리학부 from 2025. For 2027, a 2027 수시모집요강 (updated 2026-09-08, per a search summary of oku.korea.ac.kr/oku/index.do) and a 2027 정시모집요강 (posted 2026-08-31, per a summary of oku.korea.ac.kr/sejong/index.do) exist, but their unit tables could not be read. The 2027 시행계획 (2025-04) only gives the general caveat that units may be created, merged, split or renamed. No 2027 reorganization could be confirmed. Curriculum year (교육과정 연도) could not be read from any page. The 수강신청 유의사항 PDFs are labelled 2024 (info_caution_sejong_global_2024.pdf, info_caution_sejong_public_2024.pdf) but are undated in the excerpts. The sejong.korea.ac.kr 과학기술대학 page says the college has '14개 학과', which matches the 14 science and technology units listed below.
